title: Generators
description: The closed list of activity generators (contract v2) and the typed `params` object each one accepts. A generated item is fully reproducible from (generatorId, seed, params); every param has a default taken from the real-test values reported in docs/content/psy0-spec.md §2.4, so `params: {}` is always valid. Dart: enum GeneratorId + sealed GeneratorParams (lib/core/content/model/generator.dart).

GeneratorId.description: Key of an ItemGenerator in the engine registry (US-020). One per interactive PSY0 activity (EPIC-03).

GeneratedRecipe.description: The (generatorId, params) pair shared by GeneratedItem and the blueprint's generated ItemSelection. Binds `params` to the $def of the named generator.

params.description: Typed per generator (see the *Params definitions). Omitted keys take the real-test defaults. Never carry the answer here.

NbackParams.description: memory_nback (spec §2.4-A, US-026). Yes/No at a fixed cadence: does the stimulus equal the one shown n steps earlier? Defaults [reported]: 2-back, 3 colours, 42 stimuli incl. 2 primers, 1 s show + 1.5 s answer window.

n.description: How many steps back to compare (2 in 2024-2026, 3 with digits in 2023).

paletteSize.description: Distinct stimuli drawn from the engine palette (7 colours, digits 0-9, letters). Real test: 3 colours.

primers.description: Leading stimuli without a question (the first n).

stimulusMs.description: Display time of each stimulus. ExamSection.cadence overrides it when present.

answerWindowMs.description: Time to answer after the stimulus; no answer = error. ExamSection.cadence overrides it when present.

targetRatio.description: Share of stimuli that are n-back matches.

lureRatio.description: Share of stimuli matching n±1 steps back (lures). [assumed]

TubesParams.description: planning_tubes (spec §2.4-B, US-035). Minimum number of ball moves between two tube configurations, free numeric answer. Defaults: capacities 3/2/3 [reported]; the rest [assumed].

capacities.description: Capacity of each U-tube, left to right.

minMoves.description: Lowest optimal distance the generator may pick (difficulty = distance).

StimulusResponseParams.description: attention_rules (spec §2.4-C, US-029). Conditional key rules, a shape flashes 0.5 s every 3 s, live right/wrong feedback. Defaults [reported].

answerWindowMs.description: Inter-stimulus interval = time to answer. ExamSection.cadence overrides.

keys.description: The two response keys (physical keyboard); the seed picks which outcome each key gets.

ruleDepth.description: Conditional levels: 1 = key by one attribute; 2 = 'if filled -> by shape, if empty -> by colour' (real test).

ParitySequenceParams.description: attention_parity (spec §2.4-D, US-031). One item = one series: click alternately even/odd numbers in ascending order from START to END, restart on error. numberCount [reported]; range [assumed].

restartOnError.description: Real-test behaviour; false only for practice.

labelEnds.description: Show START / END labels on the first and last numbers.

OverlayGridParams.description: spatial_overlay (spec §2.4-E, US-033). Drag tiles onto a grid so the overlay algebra (navy+navy=navy, navy+grey=grey, grey+grey=navy) reproduces the target. Version II (2024->) overlaps tiles and adds black cells. Grid size [assumed].

blackCells.description: Version II: some target cells are black (blocked).

DominosParams.description: logic_dominos (spec §2.4-G, US-024). Find the missing domino (two halves 0-6) in a series/arrangement built on modulo-7 rules. All defaults [assumed].

length.description: Dominoes shown, the missing one included.

answerMode.description: pick: two 0-6 selectors (real test); mcq: 6 candidate dominoes.

AirwaysParams.description: attention_airways (spec §2.4-H, US-032). One item = one series of the flow simulation: keep <= capacity aircraft and <= blueCapacity blue aircraft in each grey zone while re-routing as few as possible. capacity/blueCapacity [reported]; the rest [assumed].

blueCapacity.description: Max blue aircraft per grey zone.

WordBoxesParams.description: verbal_boxes (spec §2.4-I, US-030). One item = one series: words appear one at a time, click the box of their lexical field. Fields come from the lexical_fields bank (US-085). boxCount/wordCount [reported]; timing [assumed].

fieldIds.description: Pin the lexical fields to use (exactly boxCount ids). Omit to let the seed sample compatible fields from the bank.

trapRatio.description: Share of words drawn from the fields' `traps` lists.

ArithmeticGridParams.description: arithmetic_grid (spec §2.4-J, US-023). A grid of equalities, some wrong; select the wrong ones and validate. 3x3 and 0-4 wrong [reported]; operand size [assumed] ('simpler than Pilotest').

ViewpointParams.description: spatial_viewpoint (spec §2.4-K, US-034). A 3-D scene and numbered viewpoints on a circle; pick the one the picture was taken from. 8 viewpoints [reported]; scene composition [assumed].

allowSymmetric.description: Allow arrangements that look identical from two viewpoints (never for exam).

CubeNetParams.description: spatial_cubes (spec §2.4-L, US-025). Reference net on the left, target net with missing faces; drag (and flip) the given faces to rebuild the same cube. Defaults [assumed].

flippable.description: Faces can be flipped by tapping (real test).

MultitaskParams.description: multitask_psychomotor (spec §2.4-M, US-036). Continuous keyboard task: track a circle with the arrow keys, press shapeKey when the inner shape matches the reference, press calcKey when the framed calculation is wrong. 5 min [reported]; rates [assumed].

trackingNoise.description: Multiplier on the trajectory erraticness (real test reported 'plus erratique').

P1MathWordProblemsParams.description: p1_math_word_problems (psy1-spec.md §4.1 row 1). Multi-step word-problem arithmetic, harder than PSY0's arithmetic_grid; scratch paper allowed on the real test. Defaults [estimated] from the 2024 debrief (30 q / 35 min).

maxSteps.description: Arithmetic steps chained in one problem.

P1TangramParams.description: p1_tangram (psy1-spec.md §4.1 row 2). Compose a shape from a fixed piece set, or (2024 variant) count how many times a given piece occurs in it. Defaults [estimated] (24 planches / ~20 min).

P1AttentionSustainedParams.description: p1_attention_sustained (psy1-spec.md §4.1 row 3, US-115). Format is an [open question]; a cadence-driven target-detection stream (attention_rules/memory_nback-style). Each series fixes one target rule (shape+colour conjunction, or 'same shape as previous') from the run seed. Defaults [assumed] (3 series of 5, ~9 min; ratios/palettes picked to keep targets rare).

targetRatio.description: Share of a series' items that are true targets.

lureRatio.description: Share that are lures (share exactly one attribute with the target rule without matching it).

P1ReadingFrParams.description: p1_reading_fr (psy1-spec.md §4.1 row 4). French-language reading comprehension, same MCQ-on-passage shape as PSY0's english bank. Defaults [estimated] (10 texts / 20 min); a bank of authored passages (US-103) feeds it, this only sizes a generated session.

P1AnglesParams.description: p1_angles (psy1-spec.md §4.1 row 5). Among optionCount candidate angle values, select up to maxCorrect. optionCount/maxCorrect [reported] (9 possibilités, max 4 bonnes réponses), the rest [assumed].

P1GeneralEfficiencyParams.description: p1_general_efficiency ("EFG", psy1-spec.md §4.1 row 6). Mixed-topic reasoning MCQ; exact item type is an [open question]. Defaults [estimated] (35 q / 30 min).

P1CountersParams.description: p1_counters (psy1-spec.md §4.1 row 7). Read values off dial/counter displays. No timing was found for the family; defaults entirely [assumed].

P1CubeNetsParams.description: p1_cube_nets (psy1-spec.md §4.1 row 8). Net-folding, extending PSY0's spatial_cubes/cube_net with an alphabet parameter (latin vs the invented "runic" set) and the rotation-matching sub-variant. phaseCount/netsPerPhase [reported] (2 phases x 10 patrons x 20 min), the rest [assumed].

includeRotationMatching.description: Add the rotation-matching sub-variant (view a reference cube, judge whether each candidate is the same object rotated or altered).

P1WmReverseSpanParams.description: p1_wm_reverse_span (psy1-spec.md §4.1 row 9). Reverse-digit working-memory span; digit-length range [reported], timing [assumed].

P1WmCalcBackParams.description: p1_wm_calc_back ("calcul memory back", psy1-spec.md §4.1 row 10). Holds intermediate results in working memory over increasing-load stages. Defaults [reported] (4 stages x 20+ calcs).

P1RavenMatricesParams.description: p1_raven_matrices (psy1-spec.md §4.1 row 11). Classic Raven-style visual matrix completion. Defaults [estimated] (30 q / 30 min).

P1MentalArithmeticParams.description: p1_mental_arithmetic ("Calcul mental 1-4", psy1-spec.md §4.1 row 12). Same underlying arithmetic generator as PSY0's arithmetic_grid, graded over four answer-format modes. Defaults [estimated] (10 per series, 4 series).

P1PsychomotorParams.description: p1_psychomotor (psy1-spec.md §4.1 row 13). Continuous 4-channel multitasking test (dual-axis tracking, gauge-nulling, letter cancellation, timed arithmetic); any sub-task in its "red zone" zeroes the whole score. Needs the joystick/gamepad input abstraction (US-102); this contract only sizes the phases. Defaults [reported] (6 x 3 min phases, calc every 12 s).
